title: FISHING CALENDAR
description: Interactive Sunshine Coast seasonal species matrix, tackle specs, and local fishing spots.
info: Build v1.4: 12-month seasonal matrix covering canals, estuaries, and offshore reefs—sortable by seasonal availability, eating quality, or species name, with tackle specs, local hotspots, and a light/dark mode toggle.

title: MAGEPUNK CHARACTER CREATOR
description: 6-step TTRPG character builder, interactive play sheet, step-dice roller, and bidirectional Fari v6 JSON matrix.
info: Fari v6 Matrix: Features a 6-step compilation wizard (identity, step-dice traits, skills, trade features, foci, grimoire, and wealth), an active play sheet with live HP/Mana and Fatigue/Demise trackers, an upsize/downsize step-dice roller (d4–d20) with Web Audio synth FX, 5 archetype presets, and full Fari v6 JSON import/export.
